svg.aria-label: The codebase-design skill. Boxes: THE STANDARDS MODE: The draft (stop); The end: the additions you approved, written (agent) | THE REVIEW MODE: Scan agent: the code against the standards pages (agent); The candidates (stop); Design agents, three or more at once, when you ask for other interfaces (agent, only when needed); The end: /roadmap add and /grill write the picked candidate as a roadmap entry (agent); The ADR offer, only for a candidate you reject for a reason a later review needs (stop).
